name: actle-corporate
description: Business edition of actle: a desktop assistant that expands shorthands in every application, learns recurring phrases in the applications a person opts in, and reports keystrokes and time saved.

scripts.check: for f in core/*.js test/*.js admin/*.js desktop/*.js desktop/adapters/*.js desktop/renderer/*.js desktop/apps/*.js desktop/apps/*/*.js desktop/renderer/apps/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
